Apply now
Congratulations on choosing UWA. We’re here to support you every step of the way on your journey to a fulfilling career.
Ready to apply for your chosen course?
To help you get started, please choose the option that best describes your application.
School leaver
All current Year 12 school leaver applications should be submitted through TISC. This includes Early Offer applications.
Follow the TISC Applying Online guide for detailed steps on the process.
Non-school leaver
To apply for entry to a bachelor’s degree or university preparation program, proceed to UWA Apply.
Postgraduate coursework
If you’re looking to apply for any of the following:
• Graduate certificate
• Graduate diploma
• Master’s degree (coursework)
Go to UWA Apply and start your application.
Applying for Doctor of Medicine
If you’re an Australian student applying for the Doctor of Medicine, apply via the Graduate Entry Medical School Admissions System (GEMSAS).
Research degree
If you are applying to study a research degree, such as PhD or Master’s by research, please submit your application through the HDR Application Portal.
International student applying directly
If you wish to apply directly to UWA, please proceed to UWA Apply.
If you are an authorised agent applying on behalf of a student, please use the agent portal.
International student applying through an agent
If you wish to apply to UWA through an agent, please contact your representative to start.
Find an agent in your country by using our handy agent search.
Short courses
Apply to UWA Plus, Uni link or UWA Access short courses via the links on the Short courses page.
Not ready to apply yet?
If you're not quite ready to start your application, view more information on how to apply first.
